listingTitle: Collect formatted Rust values without per-item allocation
title: Collect formatted Rust values without per-item allocation
why: Mapping format! and collecting into String allocates a temporary String for every iterator element.
suggestion: Create one String and append each formatted value with write! in fold or an explicit loop.
limitations: Only iterator map calls containing format! and immediately followed by an explicit collect::<String>() are reported.
Equivalent inferred collect types, nested adapters, output size, and hot-path relevance are not inferred.
